summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for Phase 9 / Tahap B · B1 Pricing Engine. All 14 tests passed successfully. Pricing Engine auto-calculates base price from configurable rules with weekend/holiday surcharges. RBAC enforced correctly. Regression tests confirm existing features (anti double-booking, payment status) still work.
passed_tests: GET /api/pricing/rules - Owner, ops_admin, driver can all access
POST /api/pricing/quote - Basic calculation with weekday (0% surcharge)
POST /api/pricing/quote - Holiday surcharge (30% on configured holiday date)
POST /api/public/trip-estimate - Works without auth, returns breakdown + total
PATCH /api/settings - Owner can update pricing_rules, ops_admin gets 403
PATCH /api/settings - Updated pricing_rules reflected in GET /api/pricing/rules
PATCH /api/settings - Quote reflects updated day_rate after settings change
POST /api/bookings - Auto-calc base_price when <= 0 using pricing_rules
POST /api/bookings - Explicit base_price > 0 is respected (override, not recalculated)
Regression - Payment status derivation (INV-3) still works
